# An @click handler that calls an async native must be wrapped in an async function.
# The generated JS addEventListener call must use "async function".

sngl compile --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# Event handler wrapper is async because its body awaits fetchHello.
grep 'addEventListener.*async function' out/index.html

# The state assignment uses await.
grep 'await fetchHello' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import api "js://./api"

component main {
    var greeting = ""
    button(text="Go", @click {
        greeting = api.fetchHello("world")
    })
    text(value=greeting)
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(name: string): Promise<string> { return "Hello " + name; }
